input: Scheduled ventures brief: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products (owner's standing brief, prompts/ventures/prompt-1.md)
errors: An old-code regression run hung (a failed assertion left the test's HTTP server open); re-ran with --test-force-exit --test-timeout.

doc_friction.issue: A hook refuses `pkill -f '[w]rangler dev'` when 'wrangler' appears anywhere else in the same command line (e.g. a path to the wrangler binary); CLAUDE.md mentions bracketing but not that the word must not appear elsewhere in the command.

The router drew 'creative' on a plain draw although the scheduled message is the ventures brief; --task with 'revenue' fixed it. prompt.md says so, but the default route command in CLAUDE.md does not.

deviations.why: Took a slice not listed in shift-roster-builder's next: (the remaining buildable items are solver internals with little user value); the owner's brief asks for deployable, sellable products and the venture finish line is a one-click self-deploy, which the team hub lacked on any free host.
deviations.did: Team hub on Cloudflare's free Workers plan (Worker + SQLite Durable Object), roster built in the browser, request checks from the published week; added it to next: as landed with 'next a live-account deploy'.
deviations.result: Verified locally on workerd via wrangler dev and Chromium; not deployed to a live account.

notes: Venture: shift-roster-builder (flagship row 4). Tests: hub-worker.test.mjs 7/7, roster-from-owner.test.mjs 2/2, server.test.mjs 20/20 (the two new regression tests fail on the old server.mjs), page+deploy 26/26. eval/hub-worker-cpu.out.txt: Worker requests 0.1-1.3 ms vs builds 11-154 ms. wrangler 4.40.0 dev: assets filtered by .assetsignore, DO persisted across restart, hub-browser.check.mjs passed against it ($3,690 sample week).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: port a Node server to Workers + Durable Objects, browser-side build, regression fixes, tests, workerd verification, docs

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
